description: Source code for the TbCopyKeysNode class, a transformation node in Thingsboard's rule engine that copies key-value pairs between message data and metadata based on configured patterns and direction.

classes.name: TbCopyKeysNode
classes.description: A transformation node that copies key-value pairs between message data and metadata based on configured patterns and direction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, compiling key patterns and setting the source of copy.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, copying key-value pairs between data and metadata according to configuration.

methods.name: getNewKeyForUpgradeFromVersionZero
methods.description: Returns the key used for upgrade logic from version zero.

methods.name: getKeyToUpgradeFromVersionOne
methods.description: Returns the key used for upgrade logic from version one.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches any of the configured key patterns.
